## &#128104;&#8205;&#128187; About Me

I'm a **Technical Product Owner & Platform Engineer at [UltaHost](https://ultahost.com)** in Egypt. I own products from the first data model to the production server. I spec, design, ship and operate them, and I run AI agents as an engineering team that has to **prove** its work: a green build with a real exit code, a multi-model review with zero critical or high findings, and a check of the live app.

Small stdlib-only Python kernel · never calls an API · MIT
